questions.question: If x - y = (7)/(4) and (1)/(x)-(1)/(y)=(14)/(3), then x³ - y³ is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x – y = (7)/(4)

(1)/(x)-(1)/(y)=(14)/(3)

**Formula used:**

x3 – y³ = (x – y)[(x – y)² + 3xy]

**Calculation:**

According to the question

(1)/(x)-(1)/(y)=(14)/(3)

⇒ -(x – y)/xy = 14/3

Putting the value of x – y in the given equation

⇒ -(7/4)/xy = 14/3

⇒ -1/xy = 14/3 × 4/7

⇒ -1/xy = 8/3

⇒ xy = -3/8

Now,

x3 – y3 = (x – y)[(x – y)2 + 3xy]

⇒ x3 – y³ = (7/4) × (49/16) – (9/8)

⇒ x³ – y³ = 7/4 × (49 – 18)/16

⇒ x3 – y³ = (7/4 × 31/16)

⇒ x3 – y³ = 217/64

**∴ The required value is 217/64**

questions.question: If a⁴ + b⁴ + a²b² = 133 and a² + b² - ab = 19, then the value of ab will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a4 + b4 + a2b2 = 133 and a2 + b2 – ab = 19

**Calculation:**

a2 + b2 – ab = 19

⇒ a² + b² = 19 + ab

And,

a4 + b4 + a2b2 = 133

⇒ a⁴ + b⁴ + 2a²b² – a²b² = 133

⇒ (a² + b²)² – a²b² = 133

⇒ (19 + ab)² – a²b² = 133

⇒ 361 + 38ab + a²b² – a²b² = 133

⇒ 38ab = 133 – 361

⇒ 38ab = -228

⇒ ab = (-228/38)

⇒ ab = -6

**∴ The required value of ab is -6**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**a4 + b4 + a2b2 = 133

(a2 + b2 – ab)(a2 + b2 + ab) = 133

⇒ 19 × (a2 + b2 + ab) = 133

⇒ a2 + b2 + ab = 7 ....(1)

And, a2 + b2 – ab = 19 ....(2)

Subtract equation (2) from equation (1),

2ab = -12

⇒ ab = -6

∴ The required value of ab is -6

questions.question: Savita spends 20% of her monthly income on groceries, 15% of the remaining on rent and then 60% of the left over on children's education and others. If she saves Rs.9,792 a month, then how much (in Rs.) does he spend on rent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Salary spent on groceries = 20%

Salary spent on the remaining on rent = 15%

Salary spent on children's education and others = 60%

Saving of Savita in a month = Rs. 9,792

**Calculation:**

Let the monthly income be 100x

Salary spent on groceries = (20% of 100x)

⇒ (100x × 20/100)

⇒ 20x

Salary spent on the remaining on rent = (15% of 80x)

⇒ (80x × 15/100)

⇒ 12x

Salary spent on children's education and others = (60% of 68x)

⇒ (68x × 60/100)

⇒ 40.8x

Remaining salary = 100x – (20 + 12 + 40.8)x

⇒ (100x – 72.8x)

⇒ 27.2x

Now, as per the question

⇒ 27.2x = 9,792

⇒ x = (9,792/27.2)

⇒ x = 360

Salary spent on rent = 12x = (12 × 360)

⇒ Rs. 4,320

**∴ Required salary spent on rent is Rs. 4,320**

questions.question: The average marks obtained by 150 students in a certain examination is 50. If the average marks of the passed students are 54 and that of the students who failed are 30, then what will be the number of the students who failed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average marks of 150 students = 50

The average marks of passed students = 54

The average marks of failed students = 30

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let the number of students who passed the examination be x

Let the number of students who failed the examination = (150 – x)

Sum of marks of 150 students = (150 × 50) = 7500

According to the question

⇒ 54x + 30(150 – x) = 7500

⇒ 54x + 4500 – 30x = 7500

⇒ 24x = 3000

⇒ x = 125

Now,

The number of students who failed the examination = (150 – 125)

⇒ 25

**∴ The number of the students who failed is 25**

questions.question: Pipes A and B can empty a full tank in 36 and 45 minutes, respectively, whereas pipe C alone can fill the tank in 15 minutes. B and C are opened together for 15 minutes, and then both are turned off and A is opened. Pipe A will empty the tank in (in minutes):
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to empty a full tank by Pipe A = 36 min

Time taken to empty a full tank by Pipe B = 45 min

Time taken to fill the tank by Pipe C = 15 min

B and C opened together = 15 min

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 36, 45 and 15 is 180

Efficiency of A = 180/36 = 5 units/min

Efficiency of B = 180/45 = 4 units/min

Efficiency of C = 180/15 = 12 units/min

Efficiency of B and C together = (12 – 4) = 8 units/min

B and C opened for 15 min = (8 × 15) units

⇒ 120 units

Now,

Pipe A will empty the tank = (120/5) mins

⇒ 24 mins

**∴ Required time is 24 mins**

questions.question: PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral with QR as the diameter of the circle. If ∠SQR = 24°, then what will be the measure of ∠QPS?
questions.solution:

∠SQR = 24°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/209c21cb68f7247dd4f1fa128a227c49e953ec91b976ce0a49422e7c134f3db7.png] 

∠QSR = 90° (Angle inscribed in a semicircle)

⇒ 24° + 90° + ∠QRS = 180° 

⇒ 114° + ∠QRS = 180° 

⇒ ∠QRS = (180° – 114°)

⇒ ∠QRS = 66° 

Now,

∠QPS + ∠QRS = 180° [sum of pair of opposite sides of cyclic quadrilateral is 180°]

⇒ ∠QPS + 66° = 180° 

⇒ ∠QPS = (180° – 66°)

⇒ ∠QPS = 114° 

**∴ The required value of ∠QPS is 114° **

questions.question: Trains A and B of lengths 329 m and 296 m, respectively, are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks, at the speeds of 85 km/h and 65 km/h, respectively. In what time (in seconds) will they cross each other?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of train A = 329 m

Length of train B = 296 m

Speed of train A = 85 km/h

Speed of train B = 65 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

To convert km/h to m/sec, multiply the given value by 5/18

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ [(329 + 296)/(85 + 65) × 18/5] m/sec

⇒ [(625/150) × 5/18] m/sec

⇒ [(625 × 18)/(150 × 5)] m/sec

⇒ (11,250/750) m/sec

⇒ 15 m/sec

**∴ Required time is 15**

questions.question: If the nine-digit number 48x4923y8 is divisible by 88, then the value of (6x + 5y) for the maximum value of y, will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The nine-digit number = 48x4923y8

Divisible by = 88

**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 8 - The last three digits of a number are divisible of 8

Divisibility rule of 11 - If the difference between the sum of the digits at odd places and even places equals 0 or divisible by 11 

**Calculation:**

We know that the last three digits of a number are divisible of 8

⇒ The number made from the last three digits without altering their position will be divisible by 8

⇒ Possible values of y = 2 and 6

⇒ y is the largest then, y = 6

Now, check the divisibility rule of 11

⇒ (4 + x + 9 + 3 + 8) – (8 + 4 + 2 + y) = 0 or 11

⇒ (4 + x + 9 + 3 + 8) – (8 + 4 + 2 + 6) = 0 or 11

⇒ (24 + x – 20) = 0 or 11

⇒ 4 + x = 0 or 11

Then, x = (11 – 4) = 7

Now,

⇒ (6x + 5y) = (6 × 7) + (5 × 6)

⇒ 42 + 30

⇒ 72

**∴ The required value is 72**
